title: fms-app dataset descriptor (info.json)
description: The one info.json shape shared by every dataset type. Prose and the reason each field exists: dataset-info.md. A dataset directory is invalid for fms-app unless this file exists in it and parses against 'base' below with a 'format' one of the five pinned in 'oneOf'. Unknown top-level keys are allowed and round-trip verbatim through the backend's 'extra' map, so a newer generator may add fields without breaking an older reader.

stamp.description: Canonical timestamp: UTC, second precision, 'Z' suffix (Rust 'now_stamp()'). Microsecond or '+00:00' forms are pre-migration artifacts and are not accepted.

language.description: BCP 47 primary subtag (optionally with an extlang), empty when unknown. Typed rather than a free label because code branches on it: simple_words maps a language to the card datasets that count for it.

sharing.description: Publication state. Authoritative on the website; local code reads 'subscribers' and never appends to it.

owner_id.description: Owner's user id (email). Gates pushes: a device refuses to push a dataset whose owner is not the logged-in user.

spec.description: Descriptor schema version. Bump only on a removal or a change of meaning — an added field is invisible to old readers thanks to the open 'extra' keys.

uuid.description: Globally unique dataset id. OPAQUE and deliberately not pattern-matched: it is a slug for the reserved Favorites dataset ('dictation-favorites') and for website-era ids ('de_a1_by_system'), and only its uniqueness matters — it keys the sync journal, the change log, and every /api/v1/datasets/{uuid}/… route. Creation and import are the moments uniqueness is asserted (assert_uuid_free).

type.description: Must equal the directory slug the dataset lives under (datasets/<type>/…). The directory is the routing authority; discovery warns and skips on mismatch.

format.description: Internal layout tag, '<type-slug>-v<N>' with the directory slug verbatim (card, not cards; read_aloud, not read-aloud).

name.description: Display name. Books called this 'title' before the unification.

description.description: Human-facing blurb only. Provenance belongs in a README.md inside the dataset, not smuggled in here.

created_at.description: Set once at creation and never rewritten — a rebuild must not pretend a dataset is younger than it is.

updated_at.description: The only field expected to move. Bumped by touch_info() on every mutation and shipped in the sync manifest.

dictation-v2.title: dictation dataset (v2 layout)
dictation-v2.description: media/ audio, subtitle/ VTT, waveform/, transcript/ and data.sqlite3 with the listen_* rows. v2 is the current row layout; v1 files are migrated, not read. The Favorites dataset is an ordinary dictation dataset whose uuid is the reserved 'dictation-favorites' — no flag distinguishes it.

card-v1.title: card dataset (v1 layout)
card-v1.description: data.sqlite3 with cards, tags and SM-2 reviews; a per-location fts5.sqlite3 FTS index (derived, never shipped). Was 'cards-v1'.

book-v1.title: book dataset (v1 layout)
book-v1.description: book.txt plus data.sqlite3 with chapters, sentences and word rows. Was 'reading-v1'; its display name was 'title'.

read_aloud-v1.title: read-aloud dataset (v1 layout)
read_aloud-v1.description: Texts to read aloud plus recorded attempts under media/. Was 'read-aloud-v1'.

wiki-v1.title: wiki dataset (v1 layout)
wiki-v1.description: A nested tree of .md files — the files are the rows, there is no data.sqlite3. The per-dataset fts5.sqlite3 index is derived and excluded from sync.
